summary: Implement RFC 6902 JSON Patch (all six ops) with RFC 6901 pointers, atomic and non-mutating.
what_tests_check: Pointer escapes incl. ~01 decode order, '' vs '/' paths, '-' index rules, leading-zero indices, add at len vs past end, move into own child vs string-prefix sibling, deep copy semantics, test-op JSON equality (1 == 1.0, true != 1, null vs missing), null values, malformed ops, atomicity and no mutation of input.
